about: Written by a person, read by run.py (tools/go-reference/README.md). For each character here every toggle her kit has is decided: on when it is on while her main talents deal damage (spec 14.4), with a label in our own words and the reason. Team buffs, stacks that need setup and windows that do not cover her main talents stay off. `main` names rows of the talents that are her main ones, where the default (the talents she has levelled highest) is wrong; `modes` fixes a state that is no switch (which Stellar kind her hits are); `party` gives the team shapes her damage depends on, the usual one and why, and the rows the team decides (README); `reads` fixes the reads of the party only she can state (her own flags). `derived_rows` gives hits that no row of HoYoLAB's prints a row of their own, named in our words, with the numbers of a row of another talent of hers (Sethos's Dusk Bolts have his Normal Attack's). Characters here get checked: true in kits.json. `unsure` names the characters whose kit the comparison with Genshin Optimizer could not prove (tools/go-reference/compare.py), each with the sentence their verdict gives under It depends. The folders weapons/ and sets/ hold the same kind of file for a weapon's or a set's toggles, one file for each item named by its key in kits.json: every toggle of it decided, with `on`, `label`, `state` and `reason` (and `covers`); an item with no file has its toggles off and switchable.
checked: 2026-11-13, against Genshin Optimizer 2c13fc40 and the game's talent text
